sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages Zora Ideale and Revelation of the Cowardly, read through search summaries only (host unreachable): Trap Magic, the Counter Trap Magic that absorbs a spell and returns it doubled, Revelation of the Cowardly (streams of ash on allies show them where his traps are).
sources.mobile_wiki: The Black Clover Mobile wiki skill Ash Magic Bullet (name only).
sources.repo_wiki: The fandom spell page Ash Curse Magic: Ash Absorbing Formation cached in the repo (.github/wiki/spell_ash_absorbing_formation.txt).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by search (pixiv encyclopedia, manga-tantei, usachannel, playnews): he draws a magic circle in ash and the trap fires on a condition; three quick traps (a binding snare, a pitfall, a mine) and the slow, strong counter trap that takes in the spells around it and returns them with double speed and power.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells_bulls.md.

spells.name: Ash Magic: Ash Bullets
spells.note: A magic bullet of ash. Mode 0 of the Ash book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Trap Magic: Ash Snare Trap
spells.note: NEW page: the quick binding trap of ash that holds whoever steps on it.

spells.name: Ash Curse Magic: Ash Absorbing Formation
spells.note: Streams of cursed ash that drain mana from whoever they touch.

spells.name: Trap Magic: Counter Trap Magic
spells.ja: カウンタートラップ魔法
spells.note: NEW page: his best trap. It needs long preparation in the series; here it needs the quick traps used first. A circle that swallows the spells that enter it and throws them back doubled.

spells.name: Ash Magic: Revelation of the Cowardly
spells.note: A supplementary spell: ash on his allies shows them where his traps lie. Already locked to his grimoire.

planned.name: Trap Magic: pitfall and mine traps
planned.note: Two more of the three quick traps; no names, the Snare Trap stands for the family.

notes: Not in Zora's grimoire (kept in the basic Ash book, no source found): Ash Cloud, Ash Shroud, Ash Soldiers, Cursed Ash. Magic Warding Ash is World Tree Magic (William's) and not an Ash spell.
